component.name: Adorn
component.summary: GNOME Customization Storefront and Desktop Tweaks

description.p: Adorn is a native GTK4 and Libadwaita customization storefront and desktop tweaks manager for the GNOME desktop.

ul.li: Browse and install GNOME Shell extensions directly from extensions.gnome.org
Discover themes, icon packs, cursors, and wallpapers from OpenDesktop / gnome-look.org
Manage and configure active customizations with local backup protection
Download manager with live progress, retry, and cancellation controls
Curated, conflict-free desktop tweaks tailored for modern GNOME

description.p: Initial release of Adorn featuring unified storefront, local library manager, and focused desktop tweaks.
